text.card: Change one letter at a time through a ten-word bank from COLD toward WARM.
text.word_changed: That choice starts from another word. Read the current word and choose an offered one-letter change.
text.hands_empty: Put down what you hold before changing the current word.
text.rules: The middle row is the current word. Each offered choice changes exactly one letter in the same position and leaves the other three letters unchanged. Select only among the declared practice bank. The far fixed S COLD reference marks the start; the near fixed T WARM reference marks the target. Default current word is COLD. Every change can be reversed through an ordinary offered choice.
text.bank: The complete allowed bank, in the public word index order, is 0=COLD, 1=CORD, 2=CARD, 3=WARD, 4=WARM, 5=WORD, 6=WORM, 7=FORM, 8=FORD, 9=FARM. Read word_index with this bank to identify the current word. This is a bounded bank-selection exercise, not unrestricted English typing or dictionary validation.
text.worked: One shortest four-change route is COLD to CORD to CARD to WARD to WARM. Two other shortest routes pass through WORD then WARD, or WORD then WORM. Four is an offline property of this bank; no move counter or optimality test is stored. The goal word remains reusable and its ordinary neighboring choices remain available.
text.branch: From COLD, choose CORD, then FORD, FORM, FARM and WARM for a longer branch. Reverse or choose other offered adjacent words to backtrack and return to COLD. There is no reset or recorded chain.
text.limits: Original joined-bar letters are integral indexed indicators above their backings. Their negative spaces are not bores through the table. No loose letter custody, physical writing or erasing, unrestricted input, history, no-repeat enforcement, score, turn, solver, minimum-step counter, completion latch or timer is claimed.
